notes.title: DEMO Update : Patch 0.1.4
notes.content:
Hi
Thanks to feedback and helps from you, Overlook is getting even cozier and more relaxing to play.
Please keep the feedback coming. and I'll try to take every single one of them into account :)

full changelist :
[list]
[*] access to settings from home
[*] Improved human AI, especially their pathfinding 
[*] Improved the cursor behavior in different circumstances.
[*] Increased SFX coverage for the UI elements
[*] Other minor fixes
[*] minor visual fixes
[/list]

notes.title: DEMO Update : Patch 0.1.3
notes.content:
Hi...this is a real quick hot-fix to mainly bring accidentally removed menu buttons back :D phew!!

changes are:
[list]
[*] links in the menu are back !!!
[*] Improved panning experience
[*] minor visual fixes, including some clipping issues with some sprites
[*] more balanced sound effects
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: DEMO Update : Patch 0.1.2
notes.content:
hi everyone, 
another patch has been released for the OVERLOOK demo.

changes are:
[list]
[*] You can now use the Esc button to dismiss almost everything!
[*] Mouse middle button now could be used for panning as well as the regular way.
[*] SFX volume settings
[*] Some remastering on sound effects
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]

thank you for playing the game and please keep the feedback coming...
hope you enjoy the game as much as I do making/playing it :D

still waiting for you to join me on [url=https://discord.gg/NdKtFVqZ]Discord[/url]
